name: The Diary
desc: Tom Riddle's diary, after riddle by Maxime Rivest. Write in a note called Diary, rest your pen, and the diary drinks your ink and answers in its own hand. The answer comes from an AI you choose: your own bridge (Claude via Claude Code, or a local Ollama model) or any OpenAI-compatible API. Only the words you wrote (and, if you allow it, a picture of the page) are sent to it. Memories stay on this tablet.
